description: TY2026: SS 59A BEAT at the OBBBA-fixed 10.5% (permanent — the scheduled 12.5% was repealed; 10.1% was only the House draft). Applicable taxpayer: $600M receipts, 3%+ base-erosion test attested. MTI = 10,000,000 TI + 12,000,000 base-erosion benefits = 22,000,000 -> 10.5% = 2,310,000; regular tax 2,100,000 -> BEAT $210,000.00 (GBCs stay protected per the OBBBA).
